title: Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams has it all, there's nothing he can't do

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams has it all, there's nothing he can't do
sources.description: "Elite arm talent, playmaking ability, escape-ability. He has his legs that he can hurt a defense with. There's just so many layers to who he is as a player," Johnson said of Williams.
